{{jbocre/en}}

Eulojban is a subdialect of Lojban; specifically, a subdialect of the [[ce ki tau jau|ce ki tau jei]] dialect (thus use of Eulojban presupposes use of ce ki tau jei, and is not meant to duplicate anything already reassigned by CKTJ)

It has one characteristic feature: '''eu''' is a valid diphthong in Eulojban. This gives more room for monosyllabic cmavo.

Here are some suggested assignments for this new cmavo space (currently tentative):

* '''peu''' : = '''po'u lo'''
* '''neu''' : = '''no'u lo'''

== Categorical pronoun set ==
These are pronouns that can be used to refer to any object of that particular category; like natlang pronouns, their referent may be ambiguous. If disambiguation is needed, there's always '''goi'''...
* '''reu''' : [KOhA] pronoun: person (prenu)
* '''deu''' : [KOhA] pronoun: animal (danlu)
* '''teu''' : [KOhA] pronoun: inanimate object, includes plants (dacti jenai danlu)
* '''feu''' : [KOhA] pronoun: female (fetsi)
* '''meu''' : [KOhA] pronoun: male (nakni)
* '''zeu''' : [KOhA] pronoun: place, location (stuzi)
* '''seu''' : [KOhA] pronoun: abstractions, ideas, thoughts (su'u)
* '''xeu''' : [KOhA] pronoun: generalized person, "one"/general-you
